name: What is the process for listing and selling a luxury condo with a real estate agent?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for listing and selling a luxury condo with a real estate agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with a detailed consultation and Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) to determine an optimal listing price. Once listed, the agent will implement a tailored marketing strategy, including professional photography, virtual tours, and targeted advertising to reach affluent buyers. This often includes showcasing properties on specialized luxury real estate platforms and through exclusive networks. Offers are then negotiated, followed by inspections, appraisals, and ultimately closing. Kelby Contreras and Realty ONE Group Evolution guide clients through each step, ensuring a smooth transaction from listing to close in areas like Broward County and Palm Beach County.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves a CMA, tailored luxury marketing, offer negotiation, inspections, appraisal, and closing, all guided by your real estate agent.
